judge.shardDecision: Three members, 1,125 lines, and a code surface that reaches the schema, packages/validation, the guard stack, the holidays module and the reports service — more than one pass should hold while also walking forty requirements against three tables. I dispatched one spec-reviewer child per member (the slice's split), each carrying its files, the text of its criteria quoted, what to enumerate and a path to write to; none read the register. I held the sixteen criteria the slice marks as needing the whole bundle — the contradiction family, scope, the obligations that can only be answered across members, divergence and S-58 — and read all three members in full myself for them, plus specs/time-off/README.md and specs/organization/03-holidays.md. I opened every file a shard's claim or dismissal rested on: packages/validation/src/roles.ts, packages/validation/src/reports.ts, packages/validation/src/holiday-messages.ts, packages/validation/src/holidays.ts, apps/api/src/auth/capability.guard.ts, apps/api/src/auth/require-capability.decorator.ts, apps/api/src/holidays/holidays.controller.ts, apps/api/src/holidays/holidays.service.ts, apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma. Two of the four blockers came back from a shard; two are mine. Worth a person's attention outside the findings: shard 2 established that apps/web/src/ds.ts does not exist in this repository — @ds surfaces from packages/ds/src/index.ts as @devscribed/ds — so S-06's own text names a path that is gone. That is a defect of the register, not of this spec, and no finding may name a path outside the spec, so it is recorded here instead.

judge.shardDecision: Read myself, no shards dispatched. The slice offered one shard per member, but this is a delta pass over 418 changed lines in a 1,293-line bundle and every defect in it crosses members: a Known Gaps row against the Summary two hundred lines above it, a Verification Plan row against a case in the same file and a requirement in another, a UI Description cell against the shipped members service, a Blast Radius paragraph against a Backward Compatibility item in the area README the bundle delegates to. A shard holding one member sees none of them, and the lead would be re-reading all three members anyway for the sixteen criteria the slice marks whole-bundle. I read all three members in full, plus specs/time-off/README.md, specs/organization/README.md and specs/user-management/README.md, both prior verdicts in .workflow/refine/time-off-01.probe/1 and .../2, and the diff of every commit in the range. I opened every file a claim rests on: apps/api/src/members/members.service.ts, apps/api/src/members/members.controller.ts, apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma, packages/validation/src/index.ts, packages/validation/src/roles.ts, packages/validation/src/holiday-messages.ts, packages/validation/src/reports.ts, apps/api/src/holidays/holidays.service.ts, packages/ds/src/components/reports/ReportControls.tsx.
